ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Jurrgun uses the camera only when you tap to add a photo to your profile or a chat, or to scan a QR code at check-in.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Jurrgun opens your photos only when you tap to add a photo to your profile or a chat.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Jurrgun uses Face ID only to unlock the app, when you turn on the app lock.
